sources.title: Unlimited-OCR-GGUF · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Unlimited-OCR — GGUF GGUF quantizations of baidu/Unlimited-OCR, a 3B vision-language OCR model that pushes DeepSeek-OCR one step further (one-shot, long-horizon document parsing). This repo contains a full spread of K-quants and i-quants of the language model plus the vision projector (mmproj) needed for image input.

sources.title: Ai2 Playground
sources.snippet: The current model was fine-tuned on English documents using a multilingual base VLM; other languages may work. Try the demo on your own documents below. You can then deploy the full olmOCR toolkit on your own GPUs for efficient, scalable document processing—at an estimated cost of just $178 USD per million pages converted.
